description: Validation level of every capability: 'proven' = tested against a real transmitter / capture (proof names it); 'research' = built from published specifications and checked on synthetic signals only (sources name the research file). Every report signal carries validation = {level, ...} from this file: the technology's level, and any decoded fields of research-level field capabilities. To promote a capability after a real-transmitter test, set level to 'proven' and add proof (capture + date) here; no code changes. Shared by the Python and C++ implementations.

levels.proven: tested against a real transmitter or capture
levels.research: from published specifications; synthetic validation only; not yet tested on a real transmitter

expresslrs.proof: LIVE_ELRS_2G4_2440MHz (PHY; payload not decodable: SX1280 LI coding)

fsk_rc_link.proof: drone captures (GFSK hoppers; protocol classes are -like)

hdzero.proof: LIVE_HDZERO_5658MHz (HDZero Freestyle V2, user-confirmed: R1, 27 MHz mode, 60 fps; continual pilots, CP 1/32, preamble)

ofdm_data_link.proof: DJI_Phantom_4, LIVE_OFDM_VTX_5805MHz, D_20260609 (blind CP-OFDM; the family name is -like)

remote_id_ble.note: ASTM F3411 over BLE legacy advertising (AD 0x16, UUID 0xFFFA, app code 0x0D); synthetic: full decode at >= 12 dB SNR per advert; BT5 Long Range (LE Coded PHY S=8 / S=2, ADV_EXT_IND -> AUX_ADV_IND message pack) added 2026-10-22: synthetic only, decodes to ~1 dB in-band SNR (rc_link/ble_coded, bench/ble_coded); China GB 46750-2025 packets (0xFF type byte) in the same element / service data: research, checked against a published DJI Mini 5 Pro frame (PLAN G14)

sik_telemetry.note: SiK GFSK packet (sync 0x2DD4, PN9, NETID, length, CRC-16) + MAVLink v1/v2 (X.25 + CRC_EXTRA); synthetic: full decode >= 9 dB SNR

cofdm_video_link.note: DVB-T framing (EN 300 744) at 8/7/6/5 MHz and scaled 4/2.5/2 MHz; synthetic: detected and TPS decoded down to 0 dB in-band SNR (2K, 8/7 MHz); DVB-T2 P1 preamble (S1 / S2: profile, FFT size / GI class) added 2026-10-22, synthetic only (spec worked example, -3 dB)

crossfire.note: TBS Crossfire 150 Hz FSK (85.1 kb/s, +-42.48 kHz): 0x3E6B3E sync after the preamble, 23 / 13-byte packets (raw + PN9 de-whitened), 260 kHz grid channel and link; CRC not verifiable (per-hop init unknown). Synthetic only (20 / 12 / 14 dB)

frsky.note: FrSky D8 / D16 (CC2500, ACCST) on 2.4 GHz: sync 0xD391 / 0xD391D391 after the preamble, length byte, D8 hardware CRC-16 (0x8005, init 0xFFFF), D16 software CRC (KERMIT table MSB first, seed 0) + v2 hardware CRC; variant (D8, D16 v1 / v2 / LBT v1) and TX ID (bytes 1-2). Synthetic only: 18-20/20 at 8 dB, 14/20 at 6 dB; 0.2-0.4 ms per burst

afhds2a.note: FlySky AFHDS 2A (A7105): 2-FSK 500 kb/s +-186 kHz on 2.4 GHz; ID code 0x5475C52A after the preamble (<= 3 bit errors) -> AFHDS 2A-like; (7,4) Hamming + CRC-16 decoded under candidate conventions (2 FEC layouts x 2 nibble orders x 4 CRC variants), reported only on a CRC pass with a known packet type, naming the convention -> packet type, TX ID, RX ID, binding. Synthetic only: decode 16-20/20 at 8 dB, ID to ~4 dB; 0.3-0.8 ms

xn297_toy.note: XN297 toy drones / Bayang: GFSK 1 Mb/s 2.4 GHz, prefix 0x710F55 (<= 1 bit error), scramble table from a 7-bit LFSR seeded 0x71 (reproduces the published table start), bit-reversed scrambled payload; Bayang verified by its header byte + 8-bit sum -> address, TX ID / hop channels (bind), sticks / flags (data); CRC length constant unverified (residual reported). Synthetic only: decode ~80 % at ~19 dB in-band (h ~0.32 hard decisions)

radiolink.note: RadioLink 2.4 GHz (CC2500; T8FB / T8S air, RC4GS / RC6GS / RC8X surface, DumboRC, RC4G): GFSK 37.99 kBd +-38 kHz, doubled sync 0xABCD / 0xBADC / 0xABA5, PN9 dewhitening, CC2500 CRC-16 + checksum -> sub-protocol, TX ID, 16 x 11-bit channels, hop slot checked against the TX ID's hop table (two LCG shuffles), receiver telemetry. Synthetic only: decodes at 6 dB; the AT9S / AT10 protocol is not published and not covered

hubsan.note: Hubsan H107 / H107 Plus / H301 / H501 class (A7105): 2-FSK 100 kb/s +-186 kHz, one of 12 channels 2410-2465 MHz; session ID code after the preamble, 16-byte packet summing to 0 mod 256, model from constant bytes. Synthetic only: decodes at 6 dB

toy_drone.note: toy-drone protocols on nRF24 / XN297 at 1 Mb/s: XN297 MJXQ / CX10 / JJRC345 / H8_3D / E016H / Potensic (fixed address, length, payload checksum) and plain nRF24 V2x2 / SymaX / SymaX X5C (fixed address + nRF CRC-16, optional ESB control field) -> protocol, address, TX ID. Synthetic only; 250 kb/s XN297 and non-nRF chips (HS6200, RF2500) not covered

ieee802154.note: IEEE 802.15.4 2.4 GHz O-QPSK (XBee / Zigbee telemetry): non-coherent template demod (discriminator signs per chip, 16 symbol templates made by modulation), preamble + SFD 0xA7, PHR, FCS CRC-16 KERMIT, MAC header (type, PANs, short / extended addresses); Digi OUI 00 13 A2 -> vendor. Synthetic only: 10/10 frames at ~7 dB in-band, 0.7 ms per frame

flarm.note: FLARM beacons at 868.2 / 868.4 / 866.0 MHz: 100 kchip/s Manchester 2-FSK +-50 kHz, sync F5 31 FA B6 -> 24-bit radio ID and address type (FLARM / ICAO) from the clear header; the payload is obfuscated and not decoded. Synthetic only: 18/20 at 10 dB, 15/20 at 6 dB; 0.1-0.4 ms

mlrs.note: mLRS LoRa air modes (preamble 12, IQ never inverted, 91-byte frames: 2.4 GHz SF5-7 812.5 kHz, sub-GHz SF5 / SF6 500 kHz) -> mLRS-like; the SX127x-framed SF6 (19 Hz 7x) mode is decoded: CRC-16/MCRF4XX over bytes 0-88 (byte order / crc1 coverage variants tried) -> FrameSyncWord (per-binding ID). Synthetic only

adsl.note: ADS-L 4 SRD-860 M-band (EASA Issue 2) on the FLARM PHY: sync F5 72 4B + length, CRC-24 (Mode-S 0xFFF409), XXTEA zero-key descrambling (checked against a reference implementation) -> address table / address, payload type, Traffic fields (category 11-13 = UAS, position, exponential speed / altitude / climb). Synthetic only; O-band not covered

ogn_tracker.note: OGN tracker (OGNTP v1) on the FLARM PHY: sync 0A F3 65 6C; verified by zero Manchester violations over the 208 coded bits, header parity and a plausible position (the LDPC matrix exists only in unlicensed / GPL code and is not used: label -like) -> address, address type, aircraft type (13 = UAV), TEA zero-key de-whitened position. Synthetic only

fanet.note: FANET (LoRa SF7 BW250, sync 0xF1; EU 868.2, India 866.2 MHz): MAC header + payload parsed from CRC-valid LoRa packets -> manufacturer + device ID, message type, tracking (aircraft type 7 = UAV, position, altitude, speed, climb, heading), name; sync 0x12 accepted only for a strictly valid tracking packet. Byte-level tests only

hott.note: Graupner HoTT (CC2500 MSK 249.94 kBd): sync D391 x2, 4x4 de-interleave, K=4 rate-1/2 Viterbi (TI DN504 test vector reproduced), PN9 de-whitening, CRC-16 -> TX / RX IDs, hop table + index, 12 channels, receiver telemetry. Synthetic only; MSK polarity tried both ways

hitec.note: Hitec Optima / Minima (CC2500 MSK 249.94 kBd): sync word = TX ID (id3 id2 x2; bind D391), PN9, variable length, CRC-16, sync / TX ID cross-check -> TX ID, 9 channels, repeat flag, bind hop table, telemetry. Synthetic only

sfhss.note: Futaba S-FHSS (CC2500 2-FSK 128.14 kBd +-38 kHz): sync D391, 13 bytes, CRC-16 in CC2400 mode (init undocumented: 0xFFFF / 0x0000 tried, the passing one reported) -> TX ID, model-hint bytes (T8J / T10J / TM-FH), hop index checked against the channel, hop code, 4 x 12-bit channels. Synthetic only

uat.note: UAT 978 MHz ADS-B downlink (DO-282B): CPFSK h 0.6 phase-change slicer centred on the sync, sync 0xEACDDA4E2 (<= 4 errors), clean-room Reed-Solomon GF(256) 0x187 fcr 120 (parity checked against a reference implementation), Long / Basic as dump978 -> address, position, altitude, velocities, emitter category (14 = UAV), callsign. dump978 sample messages + synthetic IQ only (no UAT in India)

ssr_mode_ac.note: SSR Mode A/C replies (ICAO Annex 10 Vol IV): F1 / F2 20.3 us, 13 positions on the 1.45 us grid, SPI 24.65 us; garbled / off-grid replies refused; Mode A code and Gillham altitude (checked against pyModeS on all 2048 words); no parity: repetition in the block verifies. Synthetic replies only

am_voice.note: full-carrier AM voice in the aeronautical bands: envelope speech band (300-3400 Hz) >= 4 % of the carrier and 3x the noise share, phase quiet (discriminator speech band at the noise level), 25 kHz channel, 121.5 / 243.0 MHz emergency; envelope audio. Synthetic AM / FM only

ils_glide_slope.note: carrier on the 40-channel ICAO grid, envelope least squares on 90 / 150 Hz with a common tone scale (0.97-1.03) over whole 1/30 s windows -> m90, m150, DDM, SDM, side; two-frequency systems; synthetic only

ils_localizer.note: carrier on the localizer grid (odd tenths 108.10-111.95), 90 / 150 Hz DDM / SDM as for the glide slope; synthetic only

vor.note: 30 Hz AM and 9960 Hz subcarrier 30 Hz FM over whole 30 Hz periods -> radial (AM - FM phase), AM depth, deviation; synthetic only (radial within 2 deg at 25 dB in one block)

gnss_gps_l1.note: GPS L1 C/A one-block acquisition: 32 PRNs (ICD self-test octals), 4 ms coherent x 4 gate, chi2 threshold P_fa 1e-3 per PRN, refine at 2 samples / chip -> code phase, Doppler, C/N0; synthetic skies only

gnss_spoofing.note: single-snapshot indicators S1 (C/N0 > 55 dB-Hz), S2 (uniform C/N0), S3 (in-band power rise with strong tracking), S4 (multipeak); heuristic thresholds; synthetic only

gnss_jamming.note: in-band J/N >= 6 dB or narrow lines near L1 (receiver lines excluded) without >= 4 strong satellites; synthetic only

ble_tracker.note: content recognizers on CRC-valid BLE adverts: Apple Find My TLV 0x12 (device type, battery), Samsung SmartTag service data 0xFD5A/0xFD59 (state, battery, UWB), Google FMDN 0xFEAA frame 0x40/0x41, Tile 0xFEED/0xFEEC/0xFD84, Chipolo 0xFE33, IETF DULT 0xFCB2; also iBeacon, Eddystone, AirPods, Swift Pair, Fast Pair as devices. Rotating tokens only; synthetic adverts only

fm_broadcast.note: 100 kHz raster, FM discriminator: deviation, 19 kHz stereo pilot; RDS (IEC 62106): biphase BPSK at 1187.5 bit/s on 3 x pilot, (26,16) block code with offset words (worked example reproduced), error-free blocks only -> PI, PTY, PS, RadioText, clock time; synthetic stations only

ais.note: AIS 1 / 2: discriminator + one-bit integration, NRZI, HDLC de-stuffing, CRC-16/X.25 residue 0xF0B8; types 1/2/3, 4, 5, 18, 21, 24; golden vector (gpsd sentence -> on-air bits) reproduced; synthetic GMSK bursts only

aprs.note: Bell 202 AFSK 1200 bit/s on narrowband FM (any FM carrier the voice receiver finds), NRZI, HDLC frames with CRC-16/X.25 (worked example FCS 0xB7A6 reproduced), AX.25 UI addresses, APRS uncompressed / compressed (spec example) / Mic-E / status / message; synthetic packets only

ax25_packet.note: CRC-valid AX.25 UI frames whose information field is not APRS; same chain as aprs

radio_altimeter.note: STFT ridge tracks fitted as straight crossings -> rate, direction, turnarounds -> sweep bandwidth and period (ITU-R M.2059 types); synthetic only (triangle / sawtooth 104-177 MHz, amplitude down to -10 dB per sample SNR)

tpms.note: FSK 52 us symbols; Continental / VDO (Manchester, CRC-8 0x07 / 0xAA) and Toyota PMV-C210 (differential Manchester, CRC-8 0x07 / 0x80 + inverted pressure), bit conventions from rtl_433 (fact source only); synthetic only, decodes to 0 dB per-sample SNR at 2 MSps

ook_remote.note: EV1527 / PT2262 OOK PWM (sync 1 + 31 Te, 24 bits of 4 Te), no checksum: confidence from identical repeats; PT2262 tri-state reported when it fits; synthetic only (>= 6 dB per-sample SNR at 2 MSps)

keeloq_remote.note: HCS200 / 300 / 301 OOK PWM: 12 warm-up pulses, 10 Te header, 66 bits LSB first -> serial, buttons, battery, repeat (rtl_433 conventions, fact source only); the encrypted hopping part is not reported; synthetic only

ism_device.note: >= 16 OOK pulses of 50-2000 us, or a two-level FSK burst >= 2 ms, that no known protocol matched

noise_jammer.note: flat plateau, Gaussian envelope (k 2) or constant envelope with Gaussian-like instantaneous frequency, no cyclic prefix (Hann-tapered autocorrelation < 0.025), no cyclic lines, stationary per 1 ms; >= 10 MHz or allocation edges; synthetic only (LTE / NR / Wi-Fi-like OFDM at 0-10 dB rejected)

bluetooth_bredr.note: 1 Mb/s GFSK hop sliced (filter +-0.6 MHz, discriminator integrated over a symbol), 64-bit sync word within 3 bits of the (64,30) BCH codeword of its own LAP (PN 0x83848D96BBCC54FC, g 0o260534236651; LAP 0 and GIAC codewords reproduced) -> LAP, inquiry (GIAC / LIAC); UAP / NAP not recovered; synthetic only (>= ~12 dB in band); real: 0-bit-error access codes (LAP DA7476, B4BDD9) in the Phantom 4 testdata capture

field_capabilities.note: kurtosis + Alamouti pair test; validated on synthetics and real 802.11 (Microhard STBC); one real drone link, antenna count not confirmed

line-locked burst phasors at each standard's fsc (NTSC / PAL-M / PAL / PAL-N); synthetic: correct to 7 dB in-band SNR; real capture 2026-10-21: Analog_20260804-161815 (NTSC VTX) -> color_standard ntsc, coherence 0.958, swing 7.1 deg, fsc 3579650 Hz (+29 ppm). real capture 2026-10-22: LIVE_ANALOG_VTX_PAL_5740MHz (PAL colour camera, user-confirmed) -> color_standard pal, coherence 0.875, swing 45.5 deg, fsc 4433716 Hz (+22 ppm; needed the per-line detrend of the burst gate); PAL-M / PAL-N not yet seen on a real transmitter; SECAM (2026-10-21, synthetic only): no burst, line-to-line alternation of the back-porch subcarrier between Db 4.250 / Dr 4.40625 MHz (alternation ~0.6-0.7, PAL ~0), rest frequencies measured to 5 kHz; detected at 20 and 10 dB
channel table LB (5333-5613, 40 MHz step) from vendor tables; reported through channel / channel_candidates (LB*)
BLE AD structures (name, company, UUIDs, tx power) of CRC-valid adverts

ranked systems / models (DJI O1/OS1/OS2/O3/O4/O4 AU Lite vs Pro, Walksnail dual vs single antenna, AR8030 family, Lightbridge 2, Herelink, Autel, HDZero, PMP450) from Tu, CP, BW, band, channel raster, antennas, frame

ranked RC / telemetry / FLARM protocols from symbol rate, deviation, band and packet period (FrSky D8/D16/v2/LBT, RadioLink, Crossfire 150 Hz, mLRS FSK, FLARM, S-FHSS, HoTT, Hitec, ELRS GFSK/FLRC, AFHDS 2A, nRF24/XN297, OpenLRS-ng, XBee 900HP, SiK rates with h~2)
CRC-24 valid + inner CRC-16 failed = DroneID present, payload opaque (newer firmware may encrypt); Python decoder only

coherent h~0.5 GFSK (Laurent C0 matched filter, squared-symbol carrier / drift track, first-pass h estimate) + CRC-24 Chase (<=3 b-symbol flips of the 16 least reliable): BLE adverts decode ~4-5 dB lower (Remote ID: 8 dB for a 1000-bit pack, 6 dB for a 376-bit BLE 4 advert, was 12 dB). Synthetic only; every output is CRC-verified; real captures 2026-10-21 (testdata regression): every BLE advert in D_20251119-183758 and LIVE_ELRS_2G4_2440MHz decodes on the coherent path with 0 corrections, measured h 0.48-0.52, and 2 adverts the slicer missed are now CRC-valid (a SCAN_RSP from the device whose ADV_IND precedes it; an ADV_IND at 10 dB). Low-SNR gain still synthetic only

audio FM subcarrier (5.5-7 MHz) sliced +-100 kHz and FM-discriminated: exact subcarrier, RMS audio deviation, dominant tone 50 Hz-8 kHz (propeller blade-pass on a drone microphone) to ~2 Hz, spectral flatness; only above 15 dB subcarrier prominence. Synthetic only (20 / 12 dB); real capture 2026-10-22: Analog_20260804-161815 (NTSC VTX) -> subcarrier 6499966 Hz, 5.16 kHz rms, tone 239.1 Hz (21.4 dB), flatness 0.13 (content of the audio not known)
ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz LoRa: SX1280 IQ inversion = UID[5] bit 0 (or binding mode); sub-GHz never inverted. One identity bit of the binding phrase

DroneID 9-symbol (OcuSync 2/3: Mini 2, Air 2 and later) vs 8-symbol legacy (Mavic 2 / older; first symbol dropped, ZC in symbols 3/5): the CP score is ambiguous by one symbol, so the ZC pair is tested at +-1 symbol and the first slot's CP decides. Synthetic only (10 / 3 dB); also fixed the integer-bin carrier (all-symbol DC dip, iterative re-slice)

ExpressLRS sub-GHz SYNC (OTA4/OTA8): implicit-header LoRa decode (validated against gr-lora_sdr), CRC-14 0x2E57 / CRC-16 0x3D65 seeded by the packet's own UID4/UID5 (OTA 4 and 3, binding) -> fhss index, nonce, rate, TLM ratio, UID4/UID5 (+UID3 on 3.x). Synthetic SYNC packets decode to 0 dB (SF9). Model-match packets stay unverified
FrSky packets, CRC passes, variants and TX IDs (synthetic only)

blind frame structure of any undecoded FSK packet (20 kBd-1.2 MBd, >= 10 dB): preamble length, 24/32-bit sync-word candidate, payload length; known sync words (CC2500 D391 / D391D391, A7105 5475C52A, Crossfire 3E6B3E, SiK 2DD4) named as -like candidates. Synthetic only
AFHDS 2A packets, CRC passes, TX / RX IDs, packet types, binding, the FEC / CRC convention that passed (synthetic only)

model-level block {family, model, candidates, basis, evidence, unresolved_reason}: DJI DroneID product type -> model, Remote ID CTA-2063-A manufacturer code -> manufacturer (BLE + Wi-Fi), DroneID frame layout -> generation only. Tables from published sources; synthetic / table tests only

PLAN G3-G6 (synthetic only): RadioLink sub-protocol / TX ID / hop check, Hubsan ID codes / model, toy-drone protocol / TX ID, FlySky AFHDS 1 TX ID / hop table check (CRC convention unverified; header + channels + hop table otherwise), ExpressLRS LR1121 GFSK SYNC (UID4 / UID5 = sync word; whitening bit order unverified, both tried)

PLAN G1 / G2 / G7 (synthetic frames only): wfb-ng / OpenIPC / OpenHD raw 802.11 (TA = BSSID = 57:42 + link_id + radio port; default link domain 0x7505D6; content encrypted, not decrypted), ESP-NOW vendor action frames and the ExpressLRS Backpack (MSP v2 CRC-8, bind UID = MAC, VTX band / channel from the default VTX table), MAVLink in open-Wi-Fi UDP / TCP and transparent LoRa payloads (CRC_EXTRA verified)
XN297 / Bayang packets, addresses, TX IDs, packet kinds, CRC residuals (synthetic only)
802.15.4 frames, CRC passes, channels, PAN IDs, addresses, vendors (synthetic only)
FLARM beacons, radio IDs, address types (synthetic only)
mLRS packets, CRC passes, FrameSyncWords, air modes (synthetic only)
PLAN G12 (synthetic only): HoTT / Hitec / S-FHSS TX and RX IDs, packet kinds, hop table / hop check, S-FHSS model hint
PLAN G10 (synthetic / byte-level only): ADS-L, OGN tracker and FANET addresses, aircraft category / type (UAS / UAV flags), positions

field_capabilities.proof: testdata/live/LIVE_WIFI_5755MHz: 44 / 44 real HE SU PPDUs pass HE-SIG-A CRC-4 (2026-10-25)
field_capabilities.note: PLAN W2: 802.11ax HE-SIG-A (SU / MU / TB): UL/DL, BSS colour, MCS, streams, bandwidth, TXOP; colour -> BSSID through a beacon's HE Operation element; synthetic: 100 % from 8 dB in-band SNR

PLAN W1 (wifi_ofdm / wifi_ofdm_scaled / wifi_dsss): per-BSS link profiles and a drone-link verdict from identity (Remote ID, Tello SDK, MAVLink, wfb-ng, ESP-NOW, SSID / OUI) or behaviour (one client, downlink-dominant, sustained, small uplink -> 0.55 / 0.65 -like); synthetic only; an IP camera or phone hotspot streaming video looks the same in one block.
